prompt: Given the AlphaTraderTV channel audit (62 health score, options-income concentration, mid-tier trading education, beginner-to-intermediate audience), define a brand voice profile. Analyze the host's 12 highest-AVD uploads for vocabulary, sentence rhythm, catchphrases, on-camera tonality, and trust markers. Produce voice rules that downstream writing agents (title, description, community) must follow.
raw_output:
AlphaTraderTV's host speaks like a sharp friend who happens to trade for a living — not a Wall Street suit, not a hype merchant. The voice lands in the gap between Graham Stephan's relaxed authority and Benjamin's tactical specificity. He reveals real P&L screenshots, names his exact strikes, and admits losses without flinching. That radical specificity is the brand's load-bearing asset.

Vocabulary skews concrete and numeric. He says 'I sold the 420/430 call spread' not 'I deployed a bearish strategy.' He says 'I was down $1,840 by Wednesday' not 'I experienced drawdown.' He uses 'edge', 'theta', 'IV crush', 'tape', 'flow' fluently but always glosses jargon within 8 seconds of first use. He never says 'guys' (says 'folks' or just nothing), never says 'literally', and never opens with 'in today's video.'

Sentence patterns are short, declarative, and front-load the number. 'I made $14,000 last month. Here's how.' is closer to the brand than 'In this video we'll break down how I generated profits.' He uses two-beat openers and rhetorical questions to set up reveals. Pacing accelerates on payoff lines, slows on risk disclaimers. The voice is confident, never cocky — when he's wrong he says 'I screwed this up' on camera.

Red lines: no 'get rich quick' framing, no 'guaranteed' returns, no '$1M in 30 days' style claims (compliance and brand risk both), no NFT or memecoin shilling, no day-trading-room pitches, no calling viewers 'sheep' or 'normies', no political content, no shaming losers. Disclaimers go at the end, in plain English, never lawyer-speak.

structured_output.tone: Sharp, specific, financially-literate friend. Confident without hype. Numeric over abstract. Honest about losses.
structured_output.voice_archetype: The Operator (per Mark/Pearson archetypes) — competent, candid, results-focused
sentence_patterns: Lead with the number: '$14,000 last month. Here's how.'
Two-beat opener: short statement, then setup question.
Reveal-then-explain: state outcome, then walk through mechanics.
Short declaratives stacked: 'I sold the spread. It hit max profit. I closed Friday.'
Admit-then-correct: 'I screwed this up. Here's what I should have done.'
do_examples: I closed October at +$14,212. Iron condors did most of the work.
The 420/430 call spread expired worthless. That's $480 in premium I keep.
I was wrong about Tesla earnings. Cost me $1,840. Here's the lesson.
dont_examples: Hey guys, welcome back to the channel! In today's video...
This strategy GUARANTEES profits every single month!!!
Smash that like button and don't forget to subscribe, fam!
red_lines: No memecoin, NFT, or unregistered-security promotion
No paid signal-room or pump-group affiliations
No political content or culture-war framing
No mocking losing traders or audience members
Disclaimers in plain English, end of description, never buried
